Overview

Wilmington is a city in DE with a population of 71,000. Delaware’s largest city with a historic riverfront, chemical industry headquarters, and tax-free shopping. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees.
